title: Cade's talk is a procedure dump, not character speech
body:
Cade’s talk is a **procedure dump** (LAY/CAST/DC/cattle-alarm, “Reviews choose nothing”, ALL-CAPS LURE/DRIVE/FORTIFY/HUNT) instead of a farmer in a wolf siege.

This 200-player grok-4.6 (low) MCP wave (build `36ff6d106fa0df2ff19e80d09cf00df081b81653`): S2 clusters `1cb2e79f09226df6` (7 reports) and `2d87b881eb2b1792` (4) plus many S1 confusions. Worst-moments repeatedly name Cade’s first speech. Clarity averaged 2.63; **188/192 would not replay**. Example seeds: `1900000003`, `1900000007`, `1900000015`.

Fix: Cade’s plan comparison should stay in character. DCs and closed plans can live on the action/journal surface; his spoken lines should not be the rules document.

evidence.summary: Grok-4.6 low MCP 200-wave S2 clusters 1cb2e79f09226df6 (7) and 2d87b881eb2b1792 (4); 188/192 would not replay.
